recruiter.bio: I'm a Senior Technical Recruiter with 14+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience and a proven track record of attracting and closing world-class engineering talent. I operate as a trusted talent partner to hiring managers — driving full-cycle recruiting, crafting thoughtful hiring strategies, and relentlessly pursuing top-tier engineers. I combine deep sourcing expertise, including advanced research techniques and automation, with exceptional organizational skills to manage dozens of open roles while never dropping the ball. I also manage contractors at Amazon — coaching and mentoring them to do their best work. Lately I've been building AI into my recruiting workflows to surface better talent faster and operate with greater precision and velocity.

aiTools.name: Candidate Follow-up Reminder
aiTools.tagline: Never lose a strong candidate to a forgotten recycle date again.
aiTools.problem: A candidate gives a strong on-site, misses the incline by a small gap, enters the recycle period — and then we all collectively forget. Not because we don't care, but because we're juggling 47 other things. Fast forward to the recycle end date and that candidate just accepted somewhere else.
aiTools.does: One click from their Hire profile extracts their info, sets a calendar reminder for after the recycle period, and pings you on Slack with a ready-to-send re-engagement email. Setup time: 30 seconds. It also runs Debrief and Phone Screen reminders to protect our 2&5 promise — a daily email about debriefs that happened 4 days ago and phone screens that happened 2 days ago.
aiTools.impact: Actively used to track on-site candidates who missed the incline by small gaps — so when their recycle period ends, we're the first in their inbox, not the last.

aiTools.name: Hire One-Click
aiTools.tagline: One click. Candidate claimed. Communication logged.
aiTools.problem: Every candidate outreach takes 12+ clicks across the same repetitive workflow — editing Recruiter, Identified by, PACE status, saving, navigating to Communications, logging the outreach. Multiply by 40 candidates a day and you lose 30+ minutes to pure admin.
aiTools.does: Adds a single button to every candidate page on hire.amazon.com that executes the entire 7-step workflow in ~15 seconds. It auto-detects your alias, fills your name with proper profile-photo chips, sets PACE to Engaged, saves, and logs your InMail — all automatically.
aiTools.impact: Our sourcing team uses Hire One-Click daily across IRG pipelines, reclaiming 30+ minutes per recruiter per day for actual candidate engagement instead of data entry.

aiTools.name: Rush Loop Assistant
aiTools.tagline: One conversation. Loop scheduled. No chasing required.
aiTools.problem: Every RUSH loop takes days of coordination — extracting rosters from Hire, creating Slack groups, chasing 4–6 interviewers for availability, formatting loop structures by hand, and separately coordinating debriefs. HMs spend hours going back and forth instead of focusing on hiring decisions.
aiTools.does: Handles the entire workflow: scrapes the Hire roster (interviewers, backups, competencies — no shadows), creates a private Slack group, requests availability, monitors responses every 3 hours, checks calendars on demand, sends smart daily reminders only to non-responders, auto-builds a break-optimized schedule (max 2 back-to-back), proposes a debrief, and delivers a copy-paste-ready loop structure.
aiTools.impact: What used to take 2–3 days of active coordination now runs on autopilot — freeing HMs and RCs to focus on evaluating talent, not playing calendar Tetris.
